results.reason: Concrete expected result without doc support: the limit reads "≤ 60 days before `window_start`" with no reference point, while the lead-time row says "between submission and `window_start`" (../ct-gen-ai-skypermit/docs/06-business-rules.md:95, :94); the 1-minute setup margin could also land exactly on 60 days, which passes

results.title: Submit 60 days 1 min before window_start cites TSD-4 §2.2 for the TIME_WINDOW gate
results.reason: Citation is supported ("Booked too far in advance | `TSD-4 §2.2`", ../ct-gen-ai-skypermit/docs/06-business-rules.md:188), but the trigger is undefined: "≤ 60 days before `window_start`" names no moment to measure from (../ct-gen-ai-skypermit/docs/06-business-rules.md:95)

open_questions.missing: The moment the "≤ 60 days before window_start" limit is measured from (submission, creation, or other); FlightRequest has no created_at field
Same as API-FR-074: no reference point for the 60-day limit, so the failing trigger can't be set up with a defined outcome

Where a zero-length window (window_end = window_start) is refused: 400 at create, or a TIME_WINDOW gate failure at submit; 01 says only "must be after window_start" with no status or enforcement point; not tracked in 05
